name: Crabdrop
blurb: A simple and fast app to manage files stored online.
description:
A simple and fast app to manage files stored online.
Easily connect to popular cloud storage services
and move files between your computer and the cloud.

Features:

• Browse files and folders

• Upload and download files

• Drag and drop uploads

• Upload large files reliably

• See upload progress in real time

Works with AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, MinIO,
and other compatible cloud storage services.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
